name: Sha Qarot
description: Sha Qarot was a planet located in the Sha Qarot system in the Deep Core that orbited a red sun. It had a moon named Fex. Due to its poisonous atmosphere and heavy volcanic activity, Nakari Kelen thought nobody would ever want to set foot on the planet.
